summative_rubric.title: What Could Happen? — Summative Rubric
summative_rubric.purpose: Used during and after Lesson 5 to score against both expectations on a 4-level scale.

rows.expectation_text: use mathematical language, including the terms “impossible”, “possible”, and “certain”, to describe the likelihood of complementary events happening, and use that likelihood to make predictions and informed decisions

levels.descriptor: Defaults to POSSIBLE for everything. Cannot identify complement pairs.
Names I/P/C with prompts. Identifies complement pairs in obvious cases.
Independently uses likelihood vocabulary AND identifies complementary events. Predicts spinner outcomes correctly.
Distinguishes strict complements from non-complements (e.g., hot/cold has warm in between).

rows.expectation_text: make and test predictions about the likelihood that the mode(s) of a data set from one population will be the same for data collected from a different population

levels.descriptor: Cannot predict mode. Predicts same mode regardless of group.
Predicts mode for one group with prompts. Tests in second group.
Independently predicts mode in one group and accepts that another group's mode may differ.
Reasons about WHY modes differ across groups (different favourites).

summative_rubric.usage_notes: Score during Lesson 5 capstone. Level 3 is grade-level.

summative_task_script.title: Mode Prediction Capstone — Summative Administration Guide
summative_task_script.purpose: Ties the Lesson 5 capstone, the 5 stations, and the rubric together.
administration_steps: Before: photocopy templates, print rubric, ready Junior Likelihood Detective certificates.
Stations 1-5 (5 min each): each child rotates through LIKELIHOOD, COMPLEMENT, SPINNER, DICE MODE, SURVEY+PREDICT.
Station 5: survey 5 + predict another group's mode (D2.2).
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Use the Capstone Template as primary evidence. Level 3 = grade-level.

evidence_per_expectation.D2.1: Stations 1-3. Likelihood and complement identification + spinner prediction.
evidence_per_expectation.D2.2: Stations 4-5. Dice mode + survey mode + cross-group prediction.
